findings.title: no egress allowlist exists to test
findings.detail: the persona's egress-denial surface assumes an egress proxy (decision 0010 names one for a later milestone). In this MVP the only wire is the per-VM UDS muxer, so the suite asserts the structural equivalent (only the created listeners exist, no AF_VSOCK, no NIC) instead of a denial that cannot occur

findings.title: steady-state CPU does not reproduce the recorded 0.03% baseline
findings.detail: measured peak 2.250% of one core for 50 guests with the fleet's own beats configuration versus the 0.03% recorded in PORT_STATUS slice 16. The configured bar (5.0%) still passes, with a thin margin. At n=2 the same configuration measures 0.250%. The recorded figure was sampled with the guests 'parked in HLT', which measures no heartbeat writes and no console polling; noded never boots a parked guest (its cmdline builder has no halt option), and every guest it does boot writes a heartbeat every 5 s and polls its console every second, plus the run watcher's 5 ms poll pass. Those wakeups are the measured cost. A like-for-like baseline is needed: either re-sample the recorded figure with the same guest configuration, or expose a parked-guest option through noded so both states can be measured.
